vampirism_the_masquerade_villager_refuse: Villager refuse to trade with you
advancements.keep_the_masquerade.descr: Save the Masquerade before it gets out of control.
advancements.keep_the_masquerade.title: Keep the Masquerade
advancements.hunters_wrath.descr: Completely break the Masquerade, reveal your presence.
advancements.hunters_wrath.title: Hunter's Wrath
tooltip.vampirism_the_masquerade.masquer: Put on this mask to fool mortals.
vampirism_the_masquerade_hunt_end_for_no: They were temporarily defeated. But next time, they will be even more dangerous.
task.vampirism_the_masquerade.cover_lord: Trade in blood and favor; let the Royals’ iron hand crush truth and end the hunt.
task.vampirism_the_masquerade.cover_adep: Use your connections. beseech local prince to veil thy exposure in sovereign shadow.
task.vampirism_the_masquerade.cover_novi: Seek refuge with the kindred community, cover up the rumors, and mislead the hunters.
vampirism_the_masquerade.mask_talk: : Bloodkin, we can take off our masks and talk where mortals cannot see.
vampirism_the_masquerade.v_villager_warn: : Be careful, these people are curious about you.
: Watch out! Mortals are watching you.
: Don’t talk to me! If you break the Masquerade, go find a representative immediately!
vampirism_the_masquerade.v_villager_talk: : I didn't expect to meet you, Your Excellency.
: Thank you for honoring me with your presence, Your Majesty!
minion_task.vampirism_the_masquerade.cal: Your minion has begun to calm rumors. Panic in this area will slowly decrease.
vtm.intel_gained: Through your dreams, you hear mortals searching for the vampire's lair.
vtm.claim.error.no_village: This chunk does not belong to any village.
vtm.claim.error.already_claimed: This village has been claimed by %s
vtm.claim.success: Successfully claimed territory! You are now the lord of %s
vtm.command.unbind.only_player: Only players can execute this command.
vtm.command.unbind.no_village: Failed to find a valid village nearby.
vtm.command.unbind.not_claimed: The current village has not been claimed and does not need to be unbound.
vtm.command.unbind.not_lord: You are not the lord here and have no authority to break the binding.
tooltip.vampirism_the_masquerade.territo: The name of the territory will be the name of this item.
dialogue.vtm.main_npc_greeting: Bloodkin, the children of the night greet you.
dialogue.basic.q1a.low: The mortals here know almost nothing about us.
dialogue.basic.q1a.mid: Underneath, currents are stirring. Many people are talking about our kind.
dialogue.basic.q1a.high: Mortals fear us, and they have hired vampire hunters. Maybe I should move to another village.
dialogue.vtm.q2_response: You can make a mask to hide your vampire features. If you are strong enough, you can 'Disguise'.
dialogue.vtm.q3_response: If your identity is exposed, vampire hunters will immediately come after you. In this case, the local vampire representatives can help you. Even if your identity is not fully exposed, you should wait until the situation calms down before returning to the lair, otherwise the hunters might trace clues to find your home. I do not recommend confronting the hunters head-on, because they always learn from their failures.
dialogue.vtm.q1_mortal_awareness: Do the mortals here sense our presence?
dialogue.vtm.q3_things_to_note: As a vampire, are there any things I need to be aware of?
dialogue.vtm.back_to_main: Back to what we were talking about.
vtm.farmer.dialogue.start_text: If you are willing to donate some blood resources to the local warehouse, such as heart or pure blood, I can allocate the resources and manage them in an organized manner. If resources are abundant, vampires will be stronger.
vtm.farmer.dialogue.blood_received: Pure blood? Don’t worry, I won’t ask where you got it from.
vtm.farmer.dialogue.nothing_to_give: Hmm, I don’t see any resources in your hands. Could you take them out yourself, please?
vtm.farmer.dialogue.heart_received: It seems you are a cardiology specialist, right?
vtm.farmer.dialogue.warning.domain_lost: This chunk does not belong to any village. Donation cannot be completed.
vtm.farmer.dialogue.lord_level_insuffici: Pray, hold, milord. Your lord level among the Kindred commands not yet the awe of the court. Draw not undue eyes upon yourself.
vtm.claim.error.low_vampire_level: Your level is too low to have your own territory.
vtm.claim.error.max_territories: You cannot own more territory for now.
vtm.expert.dialogue.start_text: The Royals are ever ravenous for tribute. Feed their hunger, and greater privileges shall follow. Fortunate am I to know the paths that please them best. (Offer gold ingots, hearts, or Pure Bloods to the Royals and raise your donation level.)
vtm.expert.dialogue.heart_received: Heart of finest quality. Delicacy for the table.
vtm.expert.dialogue.blood_received: Some titles of lordship reclaimed? Splendid. The Royals will gladly redistribute them.
vtm.expert.dialogue.nothing_to_give: It looks like your hands are empty.
task_reward.masquerade.donation_reward: By protecting the vampire community, you will gain more praise.
vtm.priest.dialogue.start_text: My child, what are you looking for?
vtm.priest.dialogue.confirm_prayer: Child, my word still carries weight in this village. I can speak well for you to dispel their doubts. But first, I must be certain you are worth the favor.
vtm.priest.dialogue.option.no_exit: I need to think about it.
vtm.priest.dialogue.prayer_granted: I am sure you are very devout; God cannot lose a pure lamb like you. Go in peace, I shall soothe the flock when I preach. (Exposure and local panic slightly reduced)
vtm.priest.dialogue.already_prayed: I will calm the people during the sermon. You can go now.
vtm.armorer.dialogue.start_text: Though my flesh is cold as the grave, a fire burns in my heart hotter than any hearth… How wondrous.
vtm.armorer.dialogue.option.upgrade_stat: I need to upgrade local defenses.
vtm.armorer.dialogue.confirm_upgrade: My liege. If you have certain value to the Royals, you can request a batch of new equipment from them to strengthen our local Kindred.
vtm.armorer.dialogue.option.yes_upgrade: The necessary writs are prepared. (Confirm Upgrade)
vtm.armorer.dialogue.option.no_exit: I need to think about it.
vtm.armorer.dialogue.upgrade_success: Splendid, my liege. You have clad our local Kindred in stronger steel.
vtm.armorer.dialogue.not_lord: You are not the lord of this domain.
vtm.armorer.dialogue.no_domain: This is too far from the territory.
vtm.armorer.dialogue.insufficient_donati: The Royals are unlikely to agree... You know how to grease their palms, don’t you? My apologies, milord. This is simply Kindred diplomacy.
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.start_text: Milord, steel bites far deeper than claws ever could.
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.option.upgrade_: I need to upgrade local weapons.
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.confirm_upgrade: My liege. If you have certain value to the Royals, you can request a batch of new equipment from them to strengthen our local Kindred.
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.option.yes_upgr: The necessary writs are prepared. (Confirm Upgrade)
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.option.no_exit: I need to think about it.
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.upgrade_success: Excellent, milord! Our local Kindred will now tear through our enemies with far deadlier fangs!
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.not_lord: You are not the lord of this domain.
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.no_domain: This is too far from the territory.
vtm.weaponsmith.dialogue.insufficient_do: The Royals are unlikely to agree... You know how to grease their palms, don’t you? My apologies, milord. This is simply Kindred diplomacy.
vtm.hunter_expert.dialogue.start_text: Be careful, bloodkin. Don't let people notice our conversation.
vtm.hunter_expert.dialogue.trade_offer: Bloodkin, if hunters are sniffing too close to your lair, I can help mislead them. Of course, nothing in our world comes free.
vtm.hunter_expert.dialogue.option.confir: How about a heavy purse brimming with gold? (Costs 24 gold ingots)
vtm.hunter_expert.dialogue.option.cancel: I need to think about it.
vtm.hunter_expert.dialogue.trade_success: I will give you an official letter with a seal, which you can use to mislead the hunters elsewhere.
vtm.hunter_expert.dialogue.not_enough_go: You don’t have enough gold. Business is business, sorry.
vtm.hunter_expert.dialogue.inventory_ful: It looks like you can’t carry any more on yourself.
vtm.blank_letter.intel_reset: After sending the letter, you feel like you can finally get a good day’s sleep.
vtm.blank_letter.tooltip: Use it next to your coffin to temporarily prevent hunters from tracking your lair.
vtm.advisor.error.not_in_domain: We should speak in more... formal surroundings.
vtm.advisor.error.no_pure_blood_in_hand: This place could serve as home. If you want me to stay and work, you’ll need to pay me in Pure Blood.
vtm.advisor.error.low_habitability: This place is hardly fit for our kind… Come find me again once you’ve made proper arrangements.
vtm.advisor.error.max_advisors: Your current level shouldn’t have more advisors.
vtm.advisor.teleported: Advisor teleported back to home.(Coffin or Territory Center)
vtm.advisor.error.high_panic: These mortals… they reek of fear. It seems some troubles still fester in your domain.
vtm.advisor_status.defeated: A wound that refuses to mend has forced %s into torpor.
vtm.advisor.dialogue.start: Walk in safety, Majesty. The night is yours to command.
vtm.advisor.option.edicts: I want to adjust the decree.
vtm.advisor.dialogue.edicts_menu: So, what laws will you lay down?
vtm.advisor.dialogue.no_domain: This is too far from the territory.
vtm.dbno_save.beast_activated: The Beast within has been unleashed!
death.attack.vampirism_the_masquerade.be: %1$s was torn apart by the Beast within %2$s.
vtm.thrall.success: W-what are you... I am bound to your will, Master.
vtm.edict.feeding_violation: It is illegal to drink blood here. A blood hunt has been called.
vtm.edict.feeding_alert: %s is illegally drinking blood in your territory.
vtm.thrall.error.not_last_attacker: Before binding a thrall, you must first break their will with the vampire’s bite.
advancements.beastadvancement.descr: Walk as a lion among sheep. Men will tremble at your approach
advancements.beastadvancement.title: A Lion Among Sheep
advancements.thrall_advancement.descr: Thrall mortals. Let them willingly be your personal blood animals.
advancements.thrall_advancement.title: As you wish
advancements.bell_advancement.title: Come to your master.
